scope: Complete maintained result_of with typed local allocation, fifty initialization stores, actual global loads, full structure assignment including padding memory values and local free. Every finite execution prefix/return in extended library semantics; independent permissions and arbitrary words.
input: Writable aligned nonwrapping 144-byte output; arbitrary 32-bit argument words and actual source-global run/UID loads. Output need not be initialized and may alias old global storage. Fresh local is independent.
result: Exact declared field/digest values at every return, complete source trace, unchanged old memory outside output, and real freeing with no remaining local permissions. No initialized-padding claim.
nonvacuity: Actual local memory allocation for source symbols, arbitrary run/UID and argument words, uninitialized output and useful successful executions. Not whole-program initialization.
observation_boundary: A Clight structure assignment is one source step; compiled interruption granularity is an open compiler observation obligation. Loss retained at every source boundary.
tool_profile: Unchanged pinned CompCert commit 14d616046360a0b2611ebdfc2f98368af402e1f7 (VERSION 3.17), Coq 8.18.0 and OCaml 4.14.1. Source/frontend/extraction correctness remains trusted; no compiler preservation theorem applied to the extended machine.
deployment: No native, kernel, VM, runtime or hardware profile changed; preserved VM artifacts only.
